description: Check an unchanged event and signed receipt returned by get_hook_delivery within the authenticated hook. Requires the delivery token; does not send an event. A valid signature attests relay observations, not business truth or exactly-once processing.

event.description: Exact event object returned with the relay receipt; preserve all fields.

hookId.description: Hook identifier returned by registration; preserve for all subsequent operations.

receipt.description: Exact signed relay receipt from delivery lookup. Do not substitute issuer keys or edit its fields.

token.description: Private delivery token returned by registration; authenticates event submission, delivery lookup and receipt verification for this hook.

name: verify_hook_receipt
title: Verify Hook Receipt
